reference_sql:
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n_lines
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
WHERE c.parent_category = 'Accessories'
GROUP BY c.category_name
alternatives: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(l.order_line_id) AS n_lines FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00' JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id RIGHT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.parent_category = 'Accessories' GROUP BY c.category_name

SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00') AS n_lines FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE c.parent_category = 'Accessories' GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(l.order_line_id) AS n_lines FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00' JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id RIGHT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.parent_category = 'Accessories' GROUP BY c.category_name
other_way.tradeoff: Joining the week's lines first and keeping every category with RIGHT JOIN avoids a chain of LEFT JOINs, but reads backwards.

solver.query:
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(sl.order_line_id) AS n_lines
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT l.order_line_id, p.category_id
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
) sl ON sl.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.parent_category = 'Accessories'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
